_about.purpose: Pre-written triage output for every report in data/seed_reports.json, so demo/run_demo.py --offline can run the full pipeline with no AWS account and no spend.
_about.warning: THIS IS NOT MODEL OUTPUT. These summaries were written by hand to approximate what the triage agent produces. Offline mode exists so the pipeline can be exercised and demonstrated locally. It must never be recorded or presented as the agent working — see demo/offline.py.
_about.key: reporter_id|timestamp, which is unique across the seed set.
_about.what_is_still_real: Everything except the three model calls. Storage, ChromaDB retrieval and embedding, the anomaly detector, evidence computation, alert suppression, and the renderer all run for real.
